- Org / account setup and who on our side gets access

- VPC peering steps and estimated time-to-connect

We have a HIPAA review starting 11/16, so ideally the POC needs environment-ready by 11/12 so engineering can run a week of smoke tests. Can your team commit to milestone dates?

Thanks Devon — appreciate the clarity on the HIPAA window. I pulled together a concise MAP and proposed dates below (high-level):

PROPOSED MAP (milestone, owner, target)
1) Org bootstrap: Create Stethic sub-organization + admin invite — (Redwood / Rachel) — target: 2026-11-04
2) API keys provisioning: scoped API key for POC (rotating) + service account for long-running jobs — (Redwood / Marissa) — target: 2026-11-05
3) IP allowlist & firewall: Stethic provides CIDR ranges; Redwood whitelists — (Stethic / Devon -> Redwood / Marissa) — target: 2026-11-06
4) VPC peering prep: exchange peering manifest & peering ticket opened with cloud provider — (both) — target: 2026-11-08; time-to-connect dependent on cloud (typical 24–72 hrs)
5) Smoke tests & acceptance window: engineering runs 3-day smoke tests — (Stethic) — start: 2026-11-09; acceptance by 2026-11-12

We can compress steps if Stethic can provide the peering subnet details and a cloud support contact today. Marissa will add the technical checklist and a Network template. Ben — I left the commercial close item open; can you confirm if a one-week extension of the trial credit is required to cover the acceptance window?

I attached a short MAP checklist and a sample network template to speed handoff.

Next steps / asks for Stethic: please reply with the CIDR block(s) for allowlist, your cloud provider & account id for peering, and who should receive the admin invite.

Best,

Subject: Re: POC gating & timeline — technical checklist

Hi all — adding the technical detail you asked for so your infra team can work the items in parallel. See inline checklist and sample commands/notes below.

1) Org bootstrap
- I will send an invite to the email you nominate (admin@example.com) with Owner role for the Stethic sub-org. Once accepted we will create the POC project and enable audit logs.

2) API keys
- POC scoped key: created in Console -> API keys -> Create (scope: text.generate, embeddings.read). TTL: 30 days (we recommend rotation every 14 days during the POC).
- Service account (if you have batch jobs): create a service account and provide the public key for mutual TLS if needed.

3) IP allowlist
- Provide list of CIDRs for your egress: e.g., 35.160.0.0/12 (example). We'll need one /16 or narrower ranges, but we accept up to 5 entries for the POC.
- For peered VPCs we also need the peering CIDR(s) to avoid overlap.

4) VPC peering steps (AWS example)
- Stethic: create peering connection request in your VPC console -> share request id with us.
- Redwood: accept the request from our account (account id: 987654321012) and confirm routing table entries.
- Firewall: ensure return traffic allowed to our endpoint range (see attachment). Typical connect time: 1–3 business days; expedite path: open a support ticket with both cloud providers and include the peering request id.

5) Test plan (smoke tests)
- 10 short generations (<=128 tokens) across 3 model variants
- Embeddings sanity check for 100 vectors
- Latency: 95th percentile under 400ms for text.generate

Attachments included to populate fields: poc-network-template.xlsx (please fill columns A:E), rdw-map-checklist.pdf.

If you can share a point-of-contact for network (name + email + cloud support case owner), we will start the peering request the same day.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

(650) 555-0176
